description: This file contains unit tests for the QpackDecoder component of the QUIC protocol implementation, specifically testing header decoding, dynamic table management, error handling, and stream interactions within the Qpack decoder.

classes.name: QpackDecoderTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing the QpackDecoder component, parameterized by FragmentMode, providing setup, utility methods, and test cases for header decoding and error scenarios.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Decodes a complete header block from the provided data, handling setup and finalization.

methods.name: DecodeData
methods.description: Feeds data fragments into the decoder according to the current fragment mode.

methods.name: DecodeEncoderStreamData
methods.description: Feeds encoder stream data into the decoder.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes decoding by creating a new progressive decoder.

methods.name: EndDecoding
methods.description: Signals the end of header block decoding.
